signature: def build_ml_dataset(trade_log_df: pd.DataFrame, theme_df: pd.DataFrame | None = None) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict[str, pd.Series], list[str], pd.DataFrame]
requirements: Raw column names with parentheses and Korean units must be mapped to clean snake_case identifiers.
Must generate 3 target types: target_return (float clipped), target_rank (int 0~4 per daily group), target_good / target_bad (int 0/1 binary).
Must apply log scaling for skewed amounts (trade_value_100m, market_cap_100m) and signed log for net buy metrics.
Must calculate cross-sectional daily percentile ranks for key features (trade_value_pct_rank, inst_net_buy_pct_rank, change_rate_pct_rank).
Must calculate buy_price_change_rate using actual 15:19-20 execution price (buy_price) instead of API 15:30 close price.
Must exclude future leakage columns (buy_price, sell_price, raw net_return, targets, etc.) from the feature matrix X.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Columns with parentheses like '(시가총액, 억)' are properly transformed into clean names like 'market_cap_100m'.
Returns valid target_rank (0~4), target_return, target_good (0/1), and target_bad (0/1) without NaNs.
Feature matrix X does not contain buy_price, sell_price, net_return, or target columns.
